title: 8D8
subtitle: Daimyo's Majordomo
text:
Hidden
Action [Exhaust]: Deal 1 damage to another friendly unit. If you do, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a unit, reveal it, and draw it.
rules:
If a unit has Hidden and Sentinel at the same time, it can be attacked.
After searching, put any cards not chosen on the bottom of your deck in a random order.
